title: Limiting Absorption Principle and Radiation Condition for the Fractional Helmholtz Equation
summary: We investigate elliptic fractional equations in the whole space, involving zero order perturbations of the fractional Laplacian $(-Δ)^s$, $0 0$, obtained via contour integration and a limiting absorption principle. We show that its asymptotic behavior at infinity coincides with a rescaled version of the classical Helmholtz fundamental solution, thereby justifying the standard Sommerfeld radiation condition for compactly supported sources.
